title: Sage merchant record
description: A merchant record (MerchantRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another merchant record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

currency.description: The item that is money here: what the customer pays with and is paid in. Names a item record. (RecordRef<ItemRecord>)

gold.description: The merchant's purse, as they spawn and after every restock: what they can buy with. At least 0. (int, default 0)

markup.description: What they charge, times an item's value: 1.5 sells a 10 for 15. At least 0. (float, default 1.5)

pays.description: What they pay for an item, times its value: 0.5 buys a 10 for 5. At least 0. (float, default 0.5)

buys.description: The item categories they buy (an item's `category`); empty: everything but money. (List<string>)

buys+.description: Adds to "buys": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

buys-.description: Removes these from "buys" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

stock.description: A loot table rolled into their goods as they spawn and at every restock. Names a loot_table record. (RecordRef<LootTableRecord>)

restock.description: Game hours between restocks (gold and goods back to what they were); 0 = never. Unit: h. At least 0. (float, default 0)

skill.description: The customer's attribute that bargains: a barter or mercantile skill; empty: none. Names a attribute record. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

skillEffect.description: How much one point of that attribute moves a price in the customer's favour: 0.01 is a percent. (float, default 0.005)

dispositionEffect.description: How much one point of the player's standing with the merchant's faction (-100 to 100) moves a price. (float, default 0.002)

maxAdvantage.description: The most skill and standing together move a price, either way: 0.5 is half. Range: 0 to 0.949999988079071. (float, default 0.5)
